title: Finite direct image and evaluation biduality for potential complexes
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $r\geq1$, and $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$. Schemes below are Noetherian excellent schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-exc-excellent-ring]. Use pinned potential dualizing complexes for dimension functions [def-per-potential-dualizing-complex], the bounded constructible small etale category $D^b_c$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], and $D_K=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(-,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Write $\eta_M:M\to D_K^2M$ for the transpose of evaluation after symmetry of the tensor factors. Let $p:Y\to X$ be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], choose a dimension function $\delta_X$ and a pinned potential $K_X$, and use $\delta_Y=\delta_X\circ p$ and the pinned potential $K_Y=p^!K_X$ (the exceptional pullback right adjoint to finite direct image). Suppose $D_X$ and $D_Y$ preserve bounded constructible complexes. Then finite direct image $p_*$ is exact and conservative on etale $\Lambda$-module sheaves, and for every $M\in D^b_c(Y_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ the finite-duality adjunction gives an isomorphism $$p_*D_YM\cong D_Xp_*M.$$ Its iteration identifies $p_*D_Y^2M$ with $D_X^2p_*M$ and identifies $p_*\eta_M$ with $\eta_{p_*M}$. Consequently $$p_*\mathcal H^q(D_Y^2M)\cong\mathcal H^q(D_X^2p_*M)$$ for every integer $q$. If $p$ is surjective, the unit $\Lambda_X\to p_*\Lambda_Y$ is a monomorphism.

source.place: Expose XVII, proof of Proposition 6.3.1 and Lemma 6.5.3; the unit monomorphism is used in the last paragraph of 6.5
